description: A shared tally counter: make a link several people tap into one live total, then read it or add taps to it. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

action.description: create (default) makes a shared counter and returns its link. read returns the current counts. add adds taps to one counter. list returns the caller's shared counters. reset sets every counter back to zero and delete takes the link down; both are for the owner only.

counter.description: add: which counter, by position from 0 (the order they were created in). Default 0, the first.

counters.description: create: the names of the counters on the link, 1 to 8, e.g. ['In', 'Out'] or one per bird species. Default: a single counter named after the title.

locale.description: create: the language the shared page is shown in: en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl or pt. Default en.

step.description: create: how much one tap adds, 1 to 1000. Default 1. Fixed once the counter exists.

taps.description: add: how many taps, -1000 to 1000. Each tap adds the counter's step; a negative number takes taps back. Counts never go below zero. Required for add.

target.description: create: an optional goal shown as progress on the page, e.g. a venue's capacity of 250.

title.description: create: what is being counted, shown as the page heading, e.g. 'Door count'. Up to 80 characters.

token.description: The shared counter's token, from create or list, or the last part of its link. Required for read, add, reset and delete.

name: tally_counter
title: Tally Counter
